categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: the printing paper segment, producing and selling white printing paper, art paper, and copy paper; and the paperboard segment, manufacturing and selling SC Manila and Ivory paperboard. These segments cover products used in printing, office use, special functional papers, and packaging materials for confectionery, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and agricultural products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes automated large-scale capital-intensive equipment for pulp processing, paper production, and finishing processes, including coating technologies for special surface treatments. It imports pulp mainly from North America, South America, and Southeast Asia, and employs advanced R&D for eco-friendly and biodegradable packaging materials, such as the 'Green Shield' product line. Production capacity is based on daily output of pulp and coating machines at its Onsan and Hyeonpung plants.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic publishers, printing companies, wholesalers, and distributors for printing paper, and industrial users in packaging sectors such as food, cosmetics, and pharmaceuticals for paperboard. The company serves both domestic markets and exports to countries including the USA, China, Hong Kong, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Major domestic clients include Yeong-eun Paper, World Paper, KT, and Taechang Paper.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities in Ulsan (Onsan plant) and Daegu (Hyeonpung plant). It has a subsidiary in the USA (Hankuk Paper USA, Inc.) for local sales and exports directly to multiple international markets including the USA, China, Hong Kong, Japan, and Southeast Asia. The company is expanding its export markets to diversify revenue sources beyond domestic demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the paper supply chain, focusing on pulp processing, paper manufacturing, finishing, and sales. It imports raw materials such as pulp and latex and produces finished paper products for printing and packaging. It also engages in distribution and export activities, positioning itself as an integrated paper manufacturer and seller.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include horizontal integration of the paper business through mergers to complete the value chain, strengthening competitiveness, and improving operational efficiency. R&D focuses on developing eco-friendly, recyclable, and biodegradable paper products, including innovative packaging materials like 'Green Shield.' The company invests in facility upgrades and expands R&D capabilities at the Onsan plant to support product innovation and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of paper products including printing paper, special functional papers, and paperboard packaging materials. Sales occur via domestic wholesale and direct sales to end-users, as well as exports to international markets. Payment terms vary by market, including cash, promissory notes, letters of credit, and telegraphic transfers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market share domestically with approximately 19.4% in printing paper and 19.8% in paperboard segments. It faces intensified competition from imported paper products and global players, especially in the printing paper market. The company differentiates itself through product quality, technological innovation, and expanding eco-friendly product lines to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported total assets of approximately 736.9 billion KRW and total revenue of about 712 billion KRW, reflecting a 4% increase in sales compared to the previous year. Despite revenue growth, operating profit declined by 37% due to increased financial costs and market competition. The company has a stable capital structure with a debt ratio around 68% and continues to invest in capacity and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced paper products with a focus on eco-friendly and biodegradable materials to meet growing environmental demands. Its unique value lies in integrated production capabilities, a diversified product portfolio including special functional papers and packaging solutions, and a commitment to sustainability through innovative products like the 'Green Shield' recyclable packaging. This differentiation supports its competitive positioning in both domestic and international markets.
